Prep Stops
Interview prep for iOS developers

Phase 3 · Step 3.3

Design system

Built by scripts/build-design-system.mjs from config/brand.json and config/design-tokens.json. The same build writes config/generated/tokens.css for the app (Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui names). Change a value in the config, run the build, and the page and the app change together.

Stage colors (one per level, used for stage signs on the road)

freshjuniormidseniorstaff

Wrong answers use the friendly amber, not red. Red is kept for real danger, such as deleting progress.

Type

Lexend for all text, JetBrains Mono for code. Body text is 16px with a 26px line height. Lines are at most 66ch wide.

Shape, space and motion

Corners

Base radius 0.75rem. Buttons and badges are fully round.

Space

A 4px grid (0.25rem). Every tap target is at least 44px.

Motion

Calm easing, 150ms / 250ms / 450ms. When the device asks for reduced motion, every duration becomes 0.

Right and wrong also show a word, never only a color.

Progress

Progress38 of 66 topics
Path score84%

Lesson parts

Think of it like this

A photocopy changes alone. A shared document changes for everyone.

Trap

A let class instance can still change its var properties.

New in Swift 6

Structs with Sendable properties are Sendable with no extra work.

Quick check (not scored)

You copy a struct and change the copy. What happens?

Code with output

var second = first
second.x = 10
print(first.x, second.x)
0 10

Self-check (written answers)

KEY POINT Says a struct is copied

Messages

You passed! The next stop is open.
Your progress is saved in this browser.
Not quite. Here is why.

Path stops

Every state has its own shape, not only a color: check mark, double arrow, lock, dot and star.

Celebrate (small and calm)

 

Passing a topic: the stop fills in and a check mark draws in 450ms. No confetti, no sound. With reduced motion: shown at once, no animation.

The name and colors on this page come from config/brand.json. To rename the app, change it there and run the build again.
